_comment: Single source of truth. Anything in [square brackets] is an unconfirmed placeholder that Julia must supply before launch — see TODO.md. Never invent a value here.
_businessName_note: Confirmed Aug 2026. The site title, the nav lockup, og:site_name and the JSON-LD MedicalBusiness name all come from here. It must stay byte-identical to the Google Business Profile listing: conflicting name signals actively reduce confidence in the listing. Do not edit casually.
name: Julia Comstock-Ross
_url_note: Confirmed Aug 2026. The www form is canonical — the bare domain must 301 here, not merely resolve, or the two compete. Note the business card prints 'porttownsendot.com' without the www, which is normal print convention and relies on that redirect. Used for canonical, OG and sitemap URLs.
_contact_note: phoneHref is the tel: digits. Templates fall back to a marked placeholder if either is emptied, so never blank one without blanking the other.
_image_note: Both null until real assets exist. ogImage should be a 1200x630 PNG at /assets/img/og-default.png; appleTouchIcon a 180x180 PNG. A broken og:image is worse than none, so the tags are only emitted once these are set.
_contactForm_note: Turns the 'Or send a message' section on /contact/ on and off. Off for now — families phone or email, and the form still has no endpoint behind it. The markup is intact in src/contact.njk; set this true to bring it back, and set the form action at the same time or it will render its own placeholder warning.
_clientPortal_note: Julia's SimplePractice Client Portal, for EXISTING clients only — documents, intake paperwork, billing. It is not a booking link and nothing on the site should present it as one: new families phone or email. Linked from exactly one place, the footer. Renamed from bookingUrl in Aug 2026 when the bookable intro call was removed, because a key called bookingUrl that no longer drives booking is a trap for whoever reads this next.

ages.toExceptions: Older children up to 18 by arrangement — ask.

_serviceArea_note: Feeds the JSON-LD areaServed and must match the Google Business Profile service area exactly.
_remoteCounties_note: Confirmed Aug 2026. Feeds the telehealth node in the JSON-LD only. In-person work stays inside serviceArea above; these counties describe remote reach only, and the two must not be merged: the top-level areaServed has to keep matching the Google Business Profile.
travelRadius: No additional mileage charge within the service area.
_travelRadius_note: Confirmed Aug 2026: no mileage charge anywhere in the service area, absorbed into the hourly rate. Stated on /services/ and /in-home-ot/.
_services_note: Both services bill hourly. Consulting is hourly and may run longer than an hour, which the /services/ copy says explicitly.

policies.cancellation: Sessions need to be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance. Inside 24 hours the full session fee is due.
policies._superbills_note: RESOLVED: superbills are issued on request for families to submit for out-of-network reimbursement. Templates read this flag.
policies.paymentMethods: Check, credit card, HSA and FSA.
policies._mandatedReporter_note: Washington law makes a licensed OT a mandated reporter. Stated on /services/ under Confidentiality so it is never a surprise mid-relationship.
